parameters.content:
## Why event_id shows up everywhere in this workflow
The React app already generates one `event_id` per visitor and sends it in the webhook payload. Every node below just carries that same ID forward — to Meta's API, and to the Airtable row.

That's the entire deduplication mechanism: Meta sees a browser Pixel event and a server CAPI event with the *same* event_id and counts them as ONE lead, not two. If we generated a new ID here instead, every lead would get double-counted.

## Why Upsert, not Insert
Matched on `event_id`. If n8n or the browser ever retries this webhook (flaky network, timeout), this node overwrites the same Airtable row instead of creating a second lead.

This is what makes a retry safe: worst case a row gets written twice with identical data, never duplicated.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: [ { event_name: "Lead", event_time: Math.floor(new Date($json.submitted_at).getTime() / 1000), event_id: $json.event_id, action_source: "website", event_source_url: $json.tracking.page_url, user_data: { em: [$json.hashedEmail], ph: [$json.hashedPhone], fn: $json.hashedFirstName ? [$json.hashedFirstName] : undefined, ln: $json.hashedLastName ? [$json.hashedLastName] : undefined, fbp: $json.tracking.fbp || undefined, fbc: $json.tracking.fbc || undefined, client_ip_address: $json.clientIp || undefined, client_user_agent: $json.tracking.user_agent }, custom_data: { runs_ads: $json.answers.runs_ads, monthly_budget: $json.answers.monthly_budget, urgency: $json.answers.urgency } } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Send to Meta CAPI
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_PIXEL_ID in the URL once the Meta Pixel exists. continueOnFail is ON deliberately: a Meta outage should never lose a lead - it should still fall through to Airtable, just flagged as unsynced.

nodes.name: Compute Write Result
nodes.notes: Pre-computes a real boolean via ternary, same pattern as 'Record Meta Sync Result'. The IF node's built-in String isEmpty/isNotEmpty operators were unreliable evaluating $json.error / $json.id directly in this n8n instance, even against confirmed non-empty data - see ISSUE.md.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: "error", detail: "Could not save lead. Please retry." } }}
